records.quote: Here, we have synthesized crystalline halide perovskites Cs3Sb2Cl9 and Cs3Bi2Cl9 via the wet chemical process and explored the effect of lattice anharmonicity in thermal transport properties, which exhibits glassy thermal conductivity of 0.17-0.19 W m(-1) K-1 and 0.14-0.16 W m(-1) K-1 in the temperature range of 303-373 K.
context_quotes: The hierarchical chemical bonding with mixed ionic and covalent interactions and local off-centering of stereochemical active 5s2 and 6s2 lone pair of electrons on Sb and Bi generates large lattice anharmonicity resulting in soft lattice with low sound velocity (927 and 897 ms(-1)) and Debye temperature (105 and 102 K).
